slices.title: MCP observation, derivation, digest pin, drift
slices.summary: Digests MCP tool definitions in model-gateway and posts a best-effort observation batch to capability-core over an org-scoped HMAC route. First-seen tools become TOFU pins, and any description or schema change drifts the tool to tool_definition_changed; untrusted readOnlyHint derives external_write, and observation never lowers a class.

slices.title: Permission engine reads the class; MCP in Do runs
slices.summary: Makes the permission engine read the registry class and approval floor instead of name heuristics, shadow-compared first. Offers approved, digest-matched, policy-permitted MCP tools to Do runs behind MCP_DO_TOOLS (off, read, all); in read mode only read-class MCP tools are offered and executed, and ZDR refuses MCP before any network call.

slices.title: Per-tool allow/ask/never, user and org scope
slices.summary: Adds user- and org-scoped per-tool allow, ask and never policies in capability-core. Tightening applies to every row; relaxing to allow applies only to relaxable, digest-pinned mcp_tool rows; org writes need an admin scope; all writes append audit rows and are refused under ZDR. Exposed through the model-gateway proxy, the BFF and two action contracts, behind TOOL_POLICY_ENFORCED.
